# HALE MAKAWAO（ハレマカワオ）

> A private vacation rental villa in the Daisen highlands of Tottori, western Japan. One group per day. Up to 12 guests across 4 bedrooms. About 40 minutes by car from Yonago Kitaro Airport (YGJ), with direct flights from Taipei (TPE) twice a week. Just 5 minutes by car to Mt. Daisen ski resort.

## Quick facts

- **Location**: 鈑戸 1542-91, Daisen-cho, Tottori, Japan (postal 689-3317)
- **Coordinates**: 35.3833 N, 133.5333 E
- **Type**: Entire-house vacation rental (一棟貸し / 包棟別墅), one booking per day
- **Capacity**: Up to 12 guests in 4 bedrooms (mix of double / twin / Japanese-style)
- **Price**: ¥40,000 – ¥60,000 per night
- **Check-in / Check-out**: 15:00 / 10:00
- **Pets**: Not allowed
- **Smoking**: Not allowed
- **Wi-Fi**: Free, fiber-optic >100 Mbps
- **Parking**: Free, 3–4 cars
- **Languages**: 日本語 / English / 繁體中文

## Best for

- Families with children (small children welcome — fully private property)
- Multi-generational trips (grandparents + parents + kids)
- Ski / snowboard groups (Mt. Daisen ski resort 5 min by car)
- Taiwanese family travelers (direct YGJ ↔ TPE flights since May 2025)
- Off-the-beaten-path Japan travelers (rural Daisen highlands)

## Nearby attractions

- Mt. Daisen / Daisen White Resort ski area — 5 min by car
- Sakaiminato (Mizuki Shigeru Road, GeGeGe no Kitaro) — about 60 min
- Adachi Museum of Art (best Japanese garden) — about 70 min
- Tottori Sand Dunes — about 90 min
- Daisen highland farms and Daisen G-beer brewery — 10–15 min

## Meals

- Signature French toast morning set (option, advance booking)
- Tottori Wagyu BBQ hands-free set (all gear & ingredients included)
- Local restaurant shuttle plan (Sushi Tamura etc.)

## Booking

Direct bookings receive multi-night discounts (5–10% off for 3+ nights). Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in. Inquire via the website's contact form. Bookings via Airbnb follow the Airbnb cancellation policy.
